messages:
eli: FYI we lost request/response visibility for `railgun` after a tenant burst. Sampler dropped everything. We need a safer emergency workflow.
nora: saw the alert. idea: an ops 'fastlane' that temporarily routes a tenants logging to a throttled diagnostic shard instead of global drop. keeps some visibility without taking whole cluster.
chao: fastlane needs limits. propose a per-tenant "diagnostic_cap" measured in expected_exposure_tokens. no raw captures if redaction_confidence < 0.75.
ops-bot: ALERT: tenant=railgun exceeded request_log_quota (12000/min) at 2026-06-17T07:14:02Z
maddy: console UX: show a compact "Fastlane available" banner with 3 actions: Grant fastlane (ops-only), Request quota bump, Open read-only preview. Each action shows estimated privacy delta. :eyes: 
ryan: API sketch for fastlane grant: 
```
POST /internal/tenant/railgun/fastlane
{ "minutes": 10, "profile": "diag_full", "reason": "hotfix", "ticket": "SUP-4321" }
```
returns before/after exposure and a preview delta.
eli: also require audit + RBAC. CLI must be ops-only and require ticket. Example: `ri ops fastlane-grant --tenant=railgun --minutes=10 --ticket=SUP-4321 --reason="investigate"` emits immutable audit.
nora: telemetry change: add fields exposure_delta_estimate, redaction_confidence_mean, sample_profile. dashboard should surface a tiny sparkline of privacy risk next to sampling rate.
chao: enforcement: if projected exposure_delta > tenant.exposure_budget deny and suggest "isolate route" or "request reserved capacity". fallback to hashed placeholders only.
maddy: UX detail: preview modal should show 3-tiered preview: headers only, masked payload, raw (only if redaction_confidence >0.95 and ops-approved). default to masked.
ryan: rollout: ops-only fastlane first, canary 3 tenants, metrics: false_negative_redactions, exposure_spend. auto-rollback if redaction_fail_rate >2x.
eli: we also need an autosuggest in console: when route hits 70% of quota suggest either grant fastlane (ops) or enable burst credits (self-serve) with clear privacy delta.
nora: Agree. small note: prefer storing redaction_confidence as a telemetry field (0-1) and keep sampled envelopes minimal: event_id, profile, redaction_confidence, payload_hint. never embed nested JSON payloads in envelope.
chao: Implementation owners: eli -> fastlane API + CLI, nora -> console UX & autosuggest, ryan -> telemetry calc & alerts, maddy -> rollout docs & Figma. I'll add the redaction threshold safety tests.
eli: OK. Sync tomorrow 9:30 to review API contract and the audit schema. Closing: immutable audit for every fastlane grant + include ticket/reason/actor in security-audit feed. :lock:
